LESSON: NAMES OF SCRIPTURES

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Scriptures
Topic 4.1: Names of Scriptures

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Names of Scriptures. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Where is the Scripture kept (4 lessons) a) name scriptures to Granth Sahib Ji, Kalpasutra in your house?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith •

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Names of Scriptures in the examples.
2. Explain Names of Scriptures to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Names of Scriptures.
4. Show that you can: recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith •

1. Write five sentences about Names of Scriptures using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Names of Scriptures important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
